_comment: research symbol -> broker symbol. Names not listed map to themselves. 'map' applies on every broker; 'servers' holds overrides keyed by a PREFIX of the MT5 server name (ICMarketsSC matches ICMarketsSC-Demo and -Live), merged on top of 'map' at startup. Keys starting with '_' are comments. The pre-flight checks every mapped symbol exists, is tradable and has the contract/point/lot-step the research assumed; a conversion pair (USDJPY for JPY P&L etc.) only has to quote.

ICMarketsSC._comment: IC Markets. The round-3 research bars and contract specs for FRA40 and JPN225 were fetched from this server under those exact names (config/symbol_specs.json also carries F40 and JP225, which exist alongside with DIFFERENT specs: point 0.01 / lot min 0.1 instead of 0.1 / 1.0, contract 1 instead of 100), so they are NOT renamed here. If the pre-flight reports FRA40 or JPN225 'not found', add FRA40: F40 / JPN225: JP225 to this section and expect the pre-flight to then fail them on contract size, which is correct: the research was sized on the other contract. ESP35 is in no round-3 mix; its IC name is unverified (TODO).
